sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, 
which must be carried out every two years as indicated by Y2 in the title 
block.

The first draft initiated 
and tested 
by eng. Sahar Aly Rashwan at Ahliat Abu Zaabal 
SS, accepted by eng. 
Maher Ibrahem Farag general director, 
approved by eng. Ahmed Shelaby Faisal EHV North Network Head Sector, Cairo zone MPIS 
Coordinator control, and certified by eng. Mohamed Amin; head sector of substations 66/11
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the breaker and ground it.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, and
 Breathing mask ... etc.
Complete tool set, rag, air blower.
SF6 gas detector, dew point, air content and acidity equipment.
Contact resistance equipment.

Contact resistance equipment.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Clean panel exterior, 
bushings bus bars, and connectors for dust and dirt.

Check control wiring for 
loose connections and any signs of overheating and tighten all connections as 
required.

Check all the bolts of the 
main connectors at the circuit breaker terminals for looseness.

Tighten all loose bolts of 
the connection as required make note of any signs of overheating.

Check and tighten all 
ground connections as required repair any damaged ground connections.

Check control devices such 
as relays limit switches .... etc in control panel for proper operation, repair 
or replace faulty devices check hydraulic system for proper operation including 
motor, motor starter and control circuit, replace blown fuses with the same type 
and rating.

Check the operation 
mechanism of the circuit breaker, inspect for loose bolts must or linkage 
(tighten or replace parts as required).

Check gas dew point 
according to MPIS document no. TD-SS-004-r0.

Measure break and make 
time using time equipment.

Measure contact resistance 
according to MPIS document no. CB-004-r0.

Measure earth resistance 
of circuit breaker.

Check air content acidity 
content of SF6 gas according to MPIS document no TD-SS-004-r0

Check for gas leak of the 
circuit breaker the gas gauge.

Check the circuit breaker 
indications and correct its position if it is necessary.

Check the close springs 
charged indicator.

Check the trip and close 
springs visually make note of any remarks.

Through the operators 
check the circuit breaker functions from remote and local.
Check the door gasket.

Check the operation 
counter of circuit breaker.

Check closing spring 
recharge time.

Check the condition and 
setting of operating mechanism.

Check the leakage of SF6 
by halogen leak detector around the crank case core and poles of circuit breaker
